decisions.reason: Accepting HubSpot default reports temporarily does not change Apollo-to-HubSpot contact synchronization behavior or attributes.
The reporting decision does not change HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list transfer behavior or campaign import requirements.
Acceptance of HubSpot default reports is unrelated to creating MeetAlfred campaigns through Zapier.
The source decision does not alter the required Zapier account, subscription tier, or add-ons.
The HubSpot reporting solution has no effect on campaign domain setup or registration.
The temporary acceptance of default reports does not change the deferred domain warm-up requirement.
The reporting decision does not resume or otherwise modify the deferred LinkedIn campaign automation requirement.
Acceptance of HubSpot default reports does not alter the MeetAlfred account plan or setup state.
